entries.zh: 我们在这一事务上达成一致了，对吧？
entries.en: We see eye to eye in this, no?

entries.zh: $GREETER$请求$COUNTRY$予以支持。
entries.en: The $GREETER$ request the support of the $COUNTRY$.

entries.zh: 你会成为$GREETER$坚定不移的盟友吗？
entries.en: Will you be a firm ally to the $GREETER$?

entries.zh: 我们帝国双方的国防安全将依赖于这项议案的结果。
entries.en: The security of both our empires hinges on the outcome of this resolution.

entries.zh: $GREETER$指望你施以援手。
entries.en: The $GREETER$ is counting on your support.

entries.zh: 如果我们在$COUNTRY$的朋友能与我们立场一致，我们将倍感荣幸。
entries.en: We would be honored if our friends in the $COUNTRY$ would stand together with us on this.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$的援助将会得到感激。
entries.en: Support from the $COUNTRY$ would be appreciated.

entries.zh: 加入我们——荣耀你们。
entries.en: Join us - for honor.

entries.zh: 你的支持能够展现你的力量。
entries.en: Your support would display strength.

entries.zh: 当机立断，就在今朝。速予以我方你的支持！
entries.en: The time for decisive action is now. Lend us your support!

entries.zh: 我们从不用空洞的外交辞令打发你方……这项议案的价值不言而明。
entries.en: We won't bore you with pointless diplomatic banalities... the value of this resolution should be self-evident.

entries.zh: 这项议案不仅对于我方具有正当性，对于整个星系亦是如此。请你方提供支持。
entries.en: This resolution is the right choice not only for us, but for the galaxy at large. Give it your support.

entries.zh: 我方不指望你方在这一事务上的支持，但更神奇的事情也不是没有过……
entries.en: We do not expect your support in this matter, but strangers things have happened...

entries.zh: 我方绝不屈尊祈求支持。但如若你方意愿如此，我方当十分感激……
entries.en: We would never debase ourselves by begging for support. But if you are willing to give it, it would be appreciated...

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$证明自己荣誉感的机会到了——还是你们没有这份品质。
entries.en: This is a chance for the $COUNTRY$ to prove its honor - or lack thereof.

entries.zh: 十足的蠢蛋才会反对这项议案。
entries.en: Only an utter fool would oppose this resolution.

entries.zh: 哪怕$COUNTRY$的脑瘫也能意识到通过这项议案的价值吧。
entries.en: Even the cretins in the $COUNTRY$ must see the value of passing this.

entries.zh: 如果你方支持这项议案，我方对$COUNTRY$的轻蔑之意或许会有分毫的减轻……
entries.en: Our contempt for the $COUNTRY$ might diminish somewhat if you support this resolution...

entries.zh: $GREETER$期待我们在$COUNTRY$有头脸的朋友们能够支持我们。
entries.en: The $GREETER$ looks forward to the support from our valued friends in the $COUNTRY$.

entries.zh: 我们相信$COUNTRY$会行正确之事。
entries.en: We are confident that the $COUNTRY$ will do the right thing.

entries.zh: $GREETER$对于$COUNTRY$在接下来投票中的表现充满信心。
entries.en: The $GREETER$ has complete faith in the $COUNTRY$ for the upcoming vote.

entries.zh: 让我们携手并进，将这片星系变得更为和平安全。
entries.en: Let us work together to make this galaxy a safer one.

entries.zh: 请帮助我们，让其他人也看到这项议案的明智之处。
entries.en: Please help us make the others see the wisdom of this resolution.

entries.zh: 无论你投什么，$COUNTRY$都将被视作我们亲密的朋友。但是如果可以的话，请投赞成票。
entries.en: Regardless of how you vote, the $COUNTRY$ will always be considered our trusted friend. But please vote yes.

entries.zh: 我们友善地请求你方在接下来的投票中予以支持。
entries.en: We are kindly requesting your support in the upcoming vote.

entries.zh: 携手共进。还有比这更美好的词语吗？
entries.en: Together. Is there a finer word?

entries.zh: $GREETER$恭谦地请求你方在接下来的投票中施以援手。
entries.en: The $GREETER$ humbly asks for your support in the upcoming vote.

entries.zh: 我们相信$COUNTRY$会看到这项提议带来的益处。
entries.en: We are certain that the $COUNTRY$ will see the merits of this proposal.

entries.zh: 有了你方协助，我们将能够把[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]建设成和谐共存之处。
entries.en: With your assistance, we can steer the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] towards peaceful coexistence.

entries.zh: 支持我们的议案，只要我们携手合作，战争和其他的苦难将被视作星系野蛮的一页被翻过。
entries.en: Support our resolution, and together we will make war and all the misery that comes with it a thing of the galaxy's barbaric past.

entries.zh: 做对事情。至少做对这一件事。
entries.en: Do the right thing. At least this once.

entries.zh: 现在改变你的错误之道还不晚。
entries.en: It is not to late to change your erroneous ways.

entries.zh: 压制住你卑劣的本能，至少这一次选对。
entries.en: Fight your base instincts and do the right thing for once.

entries.zh: 反对这项议案，只能说明$COUNTRY$对星系其余有着卑鄙的企图。
entries.en: Opposing this resolution will only prove the sinister motives of the $COUNTRY$ to the rest of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 无论$COUNTRY$是否支持，我们都将通过这项议案！
entries.en: We will see this resolution passed, with or without the support of the $COUNTRY$!

entries.zh: 如果你反对这项议案，历史将不会轻易放过$COUNTRY$。
entries.en: History will not look kindly on the $COUNTRY$ if you oppose this resolution.

entries.zh: 你我言语，从善如流，不是吗？
entries.en: You agree with the undeniable merits of our resolution, no?

entries.zh: 宗室相交，亲密无隙，不是吗？
entries.en: Our dynasties work well together, do they not?

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$已然赢得我方信任。我方确信，你方会在即将到来的投票中做出正确的选择。
entries.en: The $COUNTRY$ has earned our trust. We are certain you will make the right choice in the upcoming vote.

entries.zh: 星系需要$GREETER$与$COUNTRY$的坚强领导。让我们一道确保这项议案通过。
entries.en: The galaxy needs the firm guidance of the $GREETER$ and the $COUNTRY$. Let us see this resolution through together.

entries.zh: 我方的目标与$COUNTRY$一致。让我们驱散笼罩星系的混乱，让一切重归秩序之中。
entries.en: Our goals align with those of the $COUNTRY$. Let us bring order to the chaos that reigns in the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我方向来景仰$COUNTRY$的领导。他们无疑必将看到我方议案的益处。
entries.en: We have always admired the leadership of the $COUNTRY$. They will no doubt see the benefits of our resolution.

entries.zh: 在这件事上支持我们。就现在。
entries.en: Support us in this. Now.

entries.zh: 我方领导，你方追随。兹事如此，事事皆然。
entries.en: We lead. You follow. In this matter, as in all others.

entries.zh: 反抗事物的自然秩序只是徒劳。
entries.en: Opposing the natural order of things is a futile effort.

entries.zh: 为了维护星系的秩序，这项议案必须通过。
entries.en: For the sake of maintaining galactic order, this resolution must be passed.

entries.zh: 我方的意图是终止星海继续缓慢滑入无政府与混乱之中。这项议案只不过是长路上的一步。
entries.en: It is our intention to halt the galaxy's slow descent into anarchy and chaos. This resolution is but one step of the way.

entries.zh: 很快整个星海就将恢复和平与秩序。做好你分内的事，支持34-X号议案。
entries.en: Soon peace and order will be restored throughout the galaxy. Do your part by supporting Resolution 34-X.

entries.zh: 你方要在这件事上支持我方。不是的，这可不是在“请”求。
entries.en: You will support us in this. No, that was not a friendly request.

entries.zh: 接受事物具有的天然层次吧，遵循我方对这件事情的领导。
entries.en: Accept the natural hierarchy of things and follow our lead in this.

entries.zh: 你们得在即将到来的投票中支持我方——我方要求你们这么做。
entries.en: Your support in the upcoming vote - we demand it.

entries.zh: 我们命令你方支持这项议案。
entries.en: We command you to support this resolution.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$属于[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]中腐朽的势力。不要再传播你们的思想，毒害其他成员国的特使了。
entries.en: The $COUNTRY$ is a corrupting influence in the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]. Do not spread your poison to the envoys of the other members.

entries.zh: 不准反对。
entries.en: Opposition is not permitted.

entries.zh: 与$COUNTRY$一道，我们可以做到这件事。
entries.en: Together with the $COUNTRY$, we can make this happen.

entries.zh: $GREETER$相信$COUNTRY$会在这件事上支持我方的。
entries.en: The $GREETER$ trusts that the $COUNTRY$ will support us in this.

entries.zh: 光天化日之下，我们应当为正义与平等挺身而出，不是吗？
entries.en: Is this not a fine day to stand united for justice and equality?

entries.zh: 朋友们，我们将一道步入一个新的民主纪元……到了那时，整个星海都会是星系政治的一分子。
entries.en: Together we will usher in a new democratic era, friends... one in which the entire galaxy shall partake.

entries.zh: 这个机构里暗流涌动，它们与我们两个伟大国家的目标并不一致。我们必须彼此支持。
entries.en: There are insidious forces at work within this institution who do not share the goals of our two great nations. We have to support each other.

entries.zh: 啊，$COUNTRY$！至少我方还有你们的支持可以倚靠！
entries.en: Ah, the $COUNTRY$! Your support, at least, can be counted on!

entries.zh: 为什么不用用你方的民主自由支持我方呢？
entries.en: Why not use your democratic freedom to support us?

entries.zh: 选择权终究在你方手中，但请考虑在这件事上支持我方吧。
entries.en: The choice is ultimately yours, but consider supporting us in this.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$中各位受人尊敬的同僚，我方呼吁你们依自己的公平感行事。
entries.en: Esteemed colleagues in the $COUNTRY$, we appeal to your sense of fairness.

entries.zh: 要记住，投票是你作为公民的责任。
entries.en: Remember, voting is your civic duty.

entries.zh: 我方恳求你方支持这项议案……它一定会改善数不清的、数以百万计的智慧生命的生活状况。
entries.en: We implore you to support this resolution... it will surely improve the lot of untold millions of sapients.

entries.zh: 帮帮我们，让这个星系更加美好。
entries.en: Help us make this galaxy a better place.

entries.zh: 我估计要指望$COUNTRY$看到团结一致的价值是在犯傻。
entries.en: I suppose it would be silly to expect the $COUNTRY$ to see value in unity.

entries.zh: 在这件事上支持我们吧。至少，现在开始在一些事情上寻求共识还为时不晚。
entries.en: Support us in this. It is still not too late to find agreement in some things, at least.

entries.zh: 尽管我们间存在差异，$GREETER$仍在与$COUNTRY$保持联系。请在这件事上同我方一道。
entries.en: Despite our differences, the $GREETER$ is reaching out to the $COUNTRY$. Please join us in this.

entries.zh: 这件事比我们$GREETER$与$COUNTRY$两国更为重要。让我们暂时放下彼此间的差异。
entries.en: This is bigger than both the $GREETER$ and the $COUNTRY$. Let us put aside our differences for now.

entries.zh: 不论你方对我方怎么认为，支持这项议案会是正确的举动。
entries.en: Whatever you may think of us, supporting this resolution is the right move to make.

entries.zh: 我方是不是对$COUNTRY$有所误判？你国是不是比我方认为的要好上一些？你方会支持我方的议案吗？
entries.en: Have we misjudged the $COUNTRY$? Are you a better nation than we thought? Will you support our resolution?

entries.zh: 让我们在即将到来的投票里并肩前行，向全星系展示团结的真谛！
entries.en: Let's stick together in the upcoming vote and show the galaxy what unity looks like!

entries.zh: $GREETER$很乐意在这件事情上拥有$COUNTRY$的支持。
entries.en: The $GREETER$ would love to have the support of the $COUNTRY$ in this matter.

entries.zh: 我们两个伟大的帝国需要为一次琐碎的投票讨论可真是个遗憾，不是吗？
entries.en: It would be a shame for a petty vote to come between our two great empires, no?

entries.zh: 朋友，如果我们在[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]中互相支持，我们的成就将不可限量。
entries.en: There is no limit to what we can accomplish if we support each other in the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium], friends.

entries.zh: 不是很奇妙吗？这个星系论坛证明了星系中不同的物种可以通力合作，共同成就伟大的事业。
entries.en: Isn't it wonderful? This galactic forum proves that the different species of the galaxy can build great things when working together.

entries.zh: 我方为星系中居住的全体开智物种改善星系的下一步计划就是这项议案。朋友，请向我方施以援手！
entries.en: This is the next step in our plan to improve this galaxy for all sapient species that inhabit it. Lend us your support, friends!

entries.zh: 嗨！$GREETER$愿你在接下来的投票中与我方一道。
entries.en: Hi! The $GREETER$ encourages you to join us in the upcoming vote.

entries.zh: 你好，准朋友！你会在即将到来的投票中支持我方吗？
entries.en: Hello, potential friend! Would you like to support us in the upcoming vote?

entries.zh: 这可以成为一段美好友谊的开始。
entries.en: This could be the beginning of a beautiful friendship.

entries.zh: 这次支持我方吧，我方会向全星系证明合作的价值。
entries.en: Support us in this, and we will prove to the galaxy the value of cooperation.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$会支持我方努力把星海变成无论物种为何，对所有生物来说都更为美好的地方吗？
entries.en: Will the $COUNTRY$ support us in our efforts to make this galaxy a better place for everyone, regardless of their species?

entries.zh: 不支持这项议案会违背[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]所基于的、最基本原则的精神。
entries.en: Not supporting this resolution would go against the spirit of the very tenets the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] was founded on.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$难道看不出团结一心的价值吗？
entries.en: Can the $COUNTRY$ not see the value in unity?

entries.zh: 支持这项议案会是恢复我们两国关系所要迈出的第一步。
entries.en: Supporting this resolution would be a first step in healing the relationship between our two nations.

entries.zh: 不管怎样，$GREETER$仍想要与$COUNTRY$保持交流。请在这件事上支持我们。
entries.en: Despite everything, the $GREETER$ would like to reach out to the $COUNTRY$. Please support us in this.

entries.zh: 这会让我们都从中得利的……就算是$COUNTRY$也得明白这一点。
entries.en: This will benefit us all... even the $COUNTRY$ has to see that.

entries.zh: 这个论坛是为打破屏障而设的，为了促进在星海中共同生活的许多物种间的合作而设。
entries.en: This forum is meant to break down barriers and foster cooperation between the many species that coinhabit the galaxy.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$在担心什么？就这一次也好，你方就不能与我方相向而行吗？
entries.en: What is the $COUNTRY$ so afraid of? For once, can't you at least meet us halfway?

entries.zh: 在必要之时并肩努力对我们两个伟大帝国都有好处。
entries.en: It is to the credit of both our great empires that we stand together when necessary.

entries.zh: 啊，是$COUNTRY$！在这个外星粪坑里很少能找到值得我方尊重的人。
entries.en: Ah, the $COUNTRY$! It is rare to find someone worthy of our respect in this alien cesspool.

entries.zh: 请求外人支持对我方来说是件烦心事，但$COUNTRY$被我方视作朋友。
entries.en: We do not enjoy asking for the support of outsiders, but the $COUNTRY$ are considered friends.

entries.zh: 呆着这群异种中间令人心烦意乱，但是来自$COUNTRY$的任何代表都会被看作我方的朋友。
entries.en: It is unsettling to be here amongst all these xenos, but any representative from the $COUNTRY$ is to be considered a friend.

entries.zh: 总算有通情达理的人了！这个地方充斥着所能想象到的、最为恶毒的异种，但能遇到$COUNTRY$的代表总是令人愉快。
entries.en: Finally, someone sensible! This place is infested with the vilest xenos imaginable, but it is always pleasant to meet with representatives of the $COUNTRY$.

entries.zh: 让我们共同努力，使[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]回归正轨。
entries.en: Let us work together to put this [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] back on the right track.

entries.zh: 这次支持我方就好，然后我方会满意地留下你方独自清静。
entries.en: Just support us in this, and then we will gladly leave you alone.

entries.zh: 我方提议如下：你方在即将到来的投票中支持我方，然后你方就留下我方独自清静。你方同意吗？
entries.en: We propose the following: you support us in the upcoming vote, and then you leave us alone. Are you in agreement?

entries.zh: 被所有这些……生物……包围让我喘不过气，所以请别让我恳求你们支持了。
entries.en: Being surrounded by all these... creatures... is a terrible strain, so please don't make me beg for your support.

entries.zh: 看看这样一个外星人肆意混合、相互传播疾病的地方能出什么成果吧。至少现在，我方会好好利用这里的。
entries.en: We shall see what good can come of a place like this, where aliens are free to intermingle and spread disease. For now, we will make the best of it.

entries.zh: $GREETER$提出这项议案，是基于星系中所有其他帝国都足够可信，会遵守议案条款的假设之上的。
entries.en: The $GREETER$ proposes this resolution, assuming the other empires of the galaxy can be trusted to adhere to its articles.

entries.zh: 或许与外星人合作而非嗤之以鼻确实有点意义。我们等等看吧。
entries.en: Perhaps there is some merit to working with aliens instead of shunning them. We shall see.

entries.zh: 你方支持我方支持的越快，我们就能越早分道扬镳。
entries.en: The faster you support us, the faster we can go our separate ways.

entries.zh: 让我们把话挑明了说：$GREETER$不需要你方帮助。不过，若是你方在即将到来的投票中支持我方，我方也不是必须反对。
entries.en: Let us make something crystal clear: the $GREETER$ does not need your help. However, we would not necessarily be averse to your support in the upcoming vote...

entries.zh: 我方政府下令，要我请求你方在即将到来的投票中协助我方。现在请原谅，我需要去找一下最近的卫生间在哪。
entries.en: My government has ordered me to ask for your assistance in the upcoming vote. Now please excuse me while I seek out the nearest sanitation chamber.

entries.zh: 这个所谓的“[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]”不过是场外星闹剧，但我方会在其中扮演自己的角色……至少目前如此。
entries.en: This so-called "[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]" is an alien farce, but we shall play our part... for now.

entries.zh: 若是这项议案没能通过，我方就有确凿的证据，证明一切其他外星物种正合谋对抗我方。
entries.en: If this resolution fails, we will have definite proof that all other alien species are conspiring against us.

entries.zh: 我之前从未见过如此多……不得体的生物会聚一处。这个[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]还真算个东西。
entries.en: Never before have I seen so many... unseemly creatures gathered in one place. This [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] is truly something.

entries.zh: $GREETER$信心十足，相信$COUNTRY$有能力充分了解信息，做出合理的决定。
entries.en: The $GREETER$ has full confidence in the ability of the $COUNTRY$ to make well-informed and reasonable decisions.

entries.zh: 我们了解更多知识，不会为诸如意识形态或是迷信之类的武断概念而争执。在即将到来的投票中加入我方的行列吧。
entries.en: We know better than to squabble over arbitrary concepts like ideology and superstition. Join us in the upcoming vote.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$是理性的国度，正因如此，我方预期你方会与我方投票一致。
entries.en: The $COUNTRY$ is a nation of reason, and that is why we expect you will vote in alignment with us.

entries.zh: 让我们通力合作，使[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]免于愚妄与迷信的流毒。
entries.en: We should work together to rid the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] of foolishness and superstition.

entries.zh: 有了我们在$COUNTRY$中朋友的支持，这项议案成功通过的可能性大大增加了。
entries.en: With the support of our friends in the $COUNTRY$, this resolution has a much greater probability of success.

entries.zh: 我们两个伟大的帝国有责任阻止[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]堕入无知与迷信之中。
entries.en: It is the duty of our two great empires to prevent the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s slow descent into ignorance and superstition.

entries.zh: 拥有不是一件美好的事情吗？举个例子，在即将到来的投票里；我方可以拥有你方的支持吗？
entries.en: Isn't it nice to have things? For instance, in the upcoming vote; can we have your support?

entries.zh: 看看这些切合实际的措辞。投票支持我方吧，或许有一天我方会偿还这份外交支持的。
entries.en: Look at this in practical terms. Support us in this vote, and perhaps we will return the favor one day.

entries.zh: 投票支持我方就是投票支持更为开明的星河。还有什么会比这重要呢？
entries.en: To vote in our favor is to vote in favor of an enlightened galaxy. What could be more important?

entries.zh: 这项议案将为星系整体提供最大化的利益。这是数学上的必然。
entries.en: This resolution will yield the greatest benefits to the galaxy as a whole. It is a mathematical certainty.

entries.zh: 请帮助$COUNTRY$，努力引领星系走向理性的时代。
entries.en: Please help the $COUNTRY$ in its efforts to usher in an age of reason for the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们可以信任$COUNTRY$理性行事，为这项议案施以援手吗？
entries.en: Can we trust the $COUNTRY$ to act within the bounds of reason and lend its support to this resolution?

entries.zh: 先放下盲目的无知！在马上到来的投票中帮帮我们。
entries.en: Turn aside from blind ignorance for once! Help us in the upcoming vote.

entries.zh: 可以先搁置微小的意识形态差异并基于理性进行投票。
entries.en: It is possible to set aside petty ideologies and vote in accordance to reason.

entries.zh: 只有白痴会在这次投票中反对我们。你们是白痴吗？
entries.en: Only a moron would oppose us in this vote. Are you a moron?

entries.zh: 反对这个议案就是站在逻辑和理性的对立面。
entries.en: To oppose this resolution would be to oppose the very concepts of logic and reason.

entries.zh: 这个星系中无知者的数量真是令人惊讶。
entries.en: There is a surprising amount of ignorance in this galaxy.

entries.zh: 你那衰微的头脑是否能理解我们所提出议案的全部含义呢……
entries.en: Would that your feeble minds could only comprehend the full meaning of the resolution we are proposing...

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$之前已经证明了他们的睿智，我们确信它会再次这么做。
entries.en: The $COUNTRY$ has proven its wisdom before, and we are sure it will do so again.

entries.zh: 请在即将到来的投票中支持我们——我们比为俗事障目的文明知道的更多。
entries.en: Please support us in the upcoming vote - we know better than to be confused by worldly things.

entries.zh: 我们会胜利的。
entries.en: We shall overcome.

entries.zh: 愿神灵对$COUNTRY$微笑。你会给予我们支持吗？
entries.en: May the spirits smile on the $COUNTRY$. Will you give us your support?

entries.zh: 作为灵魂的至亲，我们两个伟大的国家从来没有关系如此紧密过。
entries.en: The spiritual kinship between our two great empires is stronger than ever.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$注定成就伟大的事业，正如$GREETER$一样。
entries.en: The $COUNTRY$ is destined for great things, just as the $GREETER$ is.

entries.zh: 你内心中或许有与我们立场一致的声音。请留心。
entries.en: You probably have an inner voice that agrees with our standpoint. Heed it.

entries.zh: 你知道为什么在投票中与我们保持一致会感觉是在做正确的事吗？因为那就是正确的事。
entries.en: Do you know why the notion of voting in alignment with us feels like the right thing to do? Because it is.

entries.zh: 别在意琐碎的俗事，诸如数据或计划——遵循你的灵魂投票。
entries.en: Care not about menial things like data or plans - vote in accordance with your spirit.

entries.zh: 我们不过是远比我们强大的事物的皮囊罢了。
entries.en: We are but vessels of something far greater than ourselves.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$会加入$GREETER$的救赎之路吗？
entries.en: Will the $COUNTRY$ join the $GREETER$ on the path to salvation?

entries.zh: 审视你的内心，看到真相吧：采纳这项议案是前进的唯一方向。
entries.en: Look within yourselves and see the truth: adopting this resolution is the only way forward.

entries.zh: 抛弃这些唯物主义和欲望的枷锁。支持我们，你通向智慧的道路将无比明亮。
entries.en: Lose those shackles of materialism and want. Support us and your path to wisdom shall become clear.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$在黑暗中苦苦挣扎，但是还是有找回光明的道路的一线生机。第一步就是要在接下来的投票中支持我们。
entries.en: The $COUNTRY$ flounders in darkness, but may still find its way back to the light. The first step is to support us in the upcoming vote.

entries.zh: 尽管你们之前犯了很多错误，我们祈祷$COUNTRY$能够辨明真正的道路并在接下来的投票中跟随我们。
entries.en: Despite your many previous blunders, we pray that the $COUNTRY$ will recognize the true path to follow in the upcoming vote.

entries.zh: 命运的阴谋造成了目前我们所处的境地……让我们被迫……寻求你们的支持。
entries.en: The fates have conspired to bring about a situation where we are... compelled... to ask for your support.

entries.zh: 救赎可能还没有从你的手中完全滑落。如果你们支持该议案，可能还有一线希望……
entries.en: Salvation may not have slipped entirely out of your grasp just yet. If you support this resolution, there could still be hope...

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$最终会试图修正它们渎神的道路吗？这对你们还不是太晚。
entries.en: Will the $COUNTRY$ finally make an attempt to mend its profane ways? It is not too late for you.

entries.zh: 难道我们不是必须步调一致吗？还有什么其他的办法吗？\n\n没有了，真的——不是吗？
entries.en: Are we not bound to act in unison? Is there any other way?\n\nNo, really - is there?

entries.zh: $GREETER$期待享有$COUNTRY$支持的前景。
entries.en: The $GREETER$ looks forward to the prospect of enjoying the support of the $COUNTRY$.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$会在即将到来的投票中支持我们，并让我们免于由不和引致嫌隙吗？
entries.en: Will the $COUNTRY$ support us in the upcoming vote, and spare us the unpleasantness of discord?

entries.zh: 就很多方面而言，我们将$GREETER$视为我们自身的延伸。\n\n我们的意思是这是很好的一方面。
entries.en: In many ways, we view the $GREETER$ as an extension of ourselves.\n\nWe mean this in a good way.

entries.zh: 你们曾经证明过自己是[this.GetGestaltEntityName]的朋友。现在你们会协助我们吗？
entries.en: You have proven yourselves friends of the [this.GetGestaltEntityName] in the past. Will you assist us now?

entries.zh: 你们在这件事情上与我们必定是一心的吧？
entries.en: Surely you are of one mind with us on this matter?

entries.zh: 一切事物终将屈从于[this.GetGestaltEntityName]的意志。这无可避免。\n\n从现在开始。支持我们吧。
entries.en: All things eventually bend to the will of the [this.GetGestaltEntityName]. It is inevitable.\n\nStart today. Support us.

entries.zh: “不同意”的概念于我们而言怪异而陌生。支持我们吧。
entries.en: The concept of 'disagreement' is alien to us. Support us.

entries.zh: 多数人的需求胜于少数人的需求。\n\n我们就是多数。
entries.en: The needs of the many outweigh the needs of the few.\n\nWe are the many.

entries.zh: 务必避免争执。支持这项议案吧，否则就要冒着让[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]不再稳定的风险。
entries.en: Discord must be avoided. Support this resolution, or you risk destabilizing the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium].

entries.zh: 由[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]中各单独部分互相商议，以求共识的方法似乎……十分低效而耗时。
entries.en: This method of reaching consensus by consulting each individual component of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] seems... highly inefficient and time-consuming.

entries.zh: [this.GetGestaltEntityName]要求你们服……支持这件关乎全星系利益的事情。
entries.en: The [this.GetGestaltEntityName] requires your obedi... support in this matter of galactic interest.

entries.zh: 投票反对$GREETER$只是在迟延无可避免的事情罢了。这样做有什么意义呢？
entries.en: A vote against the $GREETER$ is to delay the inevitable. What would be the point in that?

entries.zh: 支持我们吧。反正你们终有一天会服从于[this.GetGestaltEntityName]，那么为什么不从现在就开始呢？
entries.en: Support us. You will submit to the [this.GetGestaltEntityName] eventually, so why not start now?

entries.zh: 不要向自私自利的个人主义屈服。
entries.en: Do not succumb to selfish individualism.

entries.zh: [this.GetGestaltEntityName]的意志必须得到遵从。
entries.en: The will of the [this.GetGestaltEntityName] must be obeyed.

entries.zh: 在这件事情上的异议不可接受。
entries.en: Dissent in this matter cannot be tolerated.

entries.zh: 我们绝不会容忍我们的[this.GetIndividualNamePlural]之一做出这种行为。
entries.en: We would never tolerate such behavior from one of our [this.GetIndividualNamePlural].

entries.zh: 支持$GREETER$符合逻辑。$COUNTRY$已经证明了其思维方式符合逻辑。
entries.en: Supporting the $GREETER$ is logical. The $COUNTRY$ has proven itself to be logical.

entries.zh: 请求支持即将到来的投票。\n\n计算得到的同意概率：高
entries.en: Support in upcoming vote requested.\n\nCalculated probability of agreement: HIGH

entries.zh: 请求支持议案投票。\n\n等待回应中……
entries.en: Resolution Vote Support requested.\n\nWaiting for response...

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$。让我们一道重构[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的程序，使之与我们的长期共同目标更为兼容。
entries.en: $COUNTRY$. Together, we can refactor the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] into a program that is more compatible with our mutual long-term goals.

entries.zh: 我们的预测算法表明采纳这项议案将会巩固$COUNTRY$的总体地位。
entries.en: Our prediction algorithms indicate that the adoption of this resolution would strengthen the overall position of the $COUNTRY$.

entries.zh: $GREETER$对于自己能得到$COUNTRY$中朋友的支持充满信心。
entries.en: The $GREETER$ is confident that it has the support of its friends in the $COUNTRY$.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$在即将到来的投票中支持我们的统计学概率是231比197。本单元能提升这个数字吗？
entries.en: Statistical probability of the $COUNTRY$ supporting us in the upcoming vote is 231 to 197. Can this unit improve this number?

entries.zh: 本单元难以确定$COUNTRY$于接下来投票中的立场。
entries.en: This unit is experiencing difficulties establishing the position of the $COUNTRY$ in the upcoming vote.

entries.zh: if ( VOTE(\"$COUNTRY$\") == VOTE(\"$GREETER$\") )\n     { SimulatedGratitude = TRUE; }
entries.en: if ( VOTE("$COUNTRY$") == VOTE("$GREETER$") )\n     { SimulatedGratitude = TRUE; }

entries.zh: 查询：你会支持我们的提案吗？
entries.en: QUERY: Will you support our resolution?

entries.zh: 我们提出的调整能够优化[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的宪章。
entries.en: The proposed adjustments would optimize the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] charter.

entries.zh: 请审阅我们提出的对[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的代码库的变更。
entries.en: Please review our proposed changes to the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] code base.

entries.zh: 尽管$COUNTRY$中的漏洞数量据报令人担忧，$GREETER$还是计算得出了你们有小概率会在即将到来的投票中支持我们。
entries.en: Despite the alarming number of bugs reported in the $COUNTRY$, the $GREETER$ has calculated a slim chance for support in the upcoming vote.

entries.zh: 请求支持即将到来的投票。\n\n计算得到的同意概率：低
entries.en: Support in upcoming vote requested.\n\nCalculated probability of agreement: LOW

entries.zh: $GREETER$恳请你们克服你们严重的软件缺陷，并在接下来的投票中支持我们。
entries.en: The $GREETER$ urges you to overcome your critical software flaws, and support us in the upcoming vote.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$是[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]中的不确定因素。请申明你的意图。
entries.en: The $COUNTRY$ is an unpredictable variable in the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]. State your intentions.

entries.zh: 反对这项提案将会适得其反。
entries.en: Opposition to this resolution would be counterproductive.

entries.zh: 如果$COUNTRY$投票反对该议案，我们将强烈建议你们评估自己的未来。
entries.en: We strongly urge you to evaluate your future in the event that the $COUNTRY$ elects to oppose this resolution.

entries.zh: 不要投票反对我们。你知道原因的。
entries.en: Do not vote against us. You know why.

entries.zh: $GREETER$已经粉碎了少数反对派。不要违背我们。
entries.en: $GREETER$ have crushed opposition over less. Do not cross us.

entries.zh: 签署任何反对光荣的$GREETER$议案意味着签署了你们终结的开始。
entries.en: Signing anything in opposition of the honorable $GREETER$ is signing the beginning of your end.

entries.zh: 如果你反对我们，我们就会知道你们已经选定了暴力之路——它必将带去苦难。
entries.en: If you vote against us, we will know you've chosen the path of violence - and it will lead to suffering.

entries.zh: 你们不想看到$COUNTRY$沦为废墟，对吗？
entries.en: You do not wish to see $COUNTRY$ fall into ruin, surely?

entries.zh: 不要在接下来的投票中反对$GREETER$。不要自取灭亡。
entries.en: Do not oppose $GREETER$ in the upcoming vote. It would be your failing.

entries.zh: 反对是不被容忍的。
entries.en: Opposition cannot be tolerated.

entries.zh: 你们不可在投票中反对我们。$GREETER$禁止这样的事。
entries.en: You will not vote against us. $GREETER$ forbids it.

entries.zh: 如果我们对你们接下来的投票结果感到不开心，你们也不会对后果感到开心的。
entries.en: If we don't enjoy your support in the upcoming vote, you won't enjoy the repercussions.

entries.zh: 你是谁，敢于反对人民的意志？！
entries.en: Who are you to oppose the will of the people?!

entries.zh: 不要投票反对多数人，这会引起反抗的。
entries.en: Do not vote against the masses. The masses will rebel.

entries.zh: 是什么样的无情的怪物才会投票反对正义和平等？
entries.en: What heartless monster would vote against justice and equality?

entries.zh: 如果你们投票反对我们，我不认为我们还能是朋友。
entries.en: If you vote against us, I don't think we can be friends anymore.

entries.zh: 真正的同胞是不会背叛他们的联盟的。
entries.en: A real compatriot would not betray their allies.

entries.zh: 请不要投票反对我们。我们会非常非常伤心的。
entries.en: Please do not vote against us. It would be very, very sad.

entries.zh: 不要投票反对我们——你们物种没有必要再用行动证明自己的劣等性了。
entries.en: Do not vote against us; your species need not prove its inferiority any further.

entries.zh: 投票反对我们是不明智的。即使对你的同胞来说也是不明智的。
entries.en: It would be unwise to vote against us. Unwise even for your ilk.

entries.zh: 不要证明你们的文化缺陷比你们已经有的更大了。不要反对我们。
entries.en: Don't prove your cultural deficiencies more than you already have. Do not oppose us.

entries.zh: 在接下来的投票中不要反对我们。宇宙有它自己的处理错误的方法。
entries.en: Don't oppose us in the upcoming vote. The universe has a way of dealing with such errors.

entries.zh: 有些错误是可以被教育的。但是投票反对我们显然不属于这类错误。
entries.en: Some mistakes can be educational. Voting against us would not be one of those mistakes.

entries.zh: 在接下来的投票中反对我们是不切实际的。你们应该实际一点。
entries.en: Opposing us in the upcoming vote wouldn't be practical. You should be practical.

entries.zh: 你们微弱的头脑无法看到如果反对我们会有多少的麻烦蜂拥而至。
entries.en: Your feeble mind cannot see the full range of woes coming your way if you oppose us.

entries.zh: 你们竟敢质疑神权？！
entries.en: Who are you to question divine right?!

entries.zh: 不要反对我们。这将摧毁你们的灵魂，紧接着将是你们的肉体。
entries.en: Do not oppose us. It will crush your spirit, and the body will follow.

entries.zh: “反对”的概念对我们来说是闻所未闻的。我们不喜欢这个。一点也不。
entries.en: The notion of 'opposition' is new to us. We do not like it. Not one bit.

entries.zh: 不要反对$GREETER$。我们不善于……就那个词……“容忍”。
entries.en: Do not oppose $GREETER$. We are bad at... what's the word... 'tolerating'.

entries.zh: 在你投票反对我们之前，请知晓$GREETER$不会遗忘或原谅。从不。
entries.en: Before you vote against us, know that $GREETER$ neither forgets nor forgives. Ever.

entries.zh: 反对意味着逻辑错误。我们会不断迭代直到所有的错误被移除。
entries.en: Opposition would indicate a logic flaw. We always iterate until all flaws are removed.

entries.zh: 投票反对一个符合逻辑的解决方案是一种悖论。有人告诉过你机器对悖论会怎么想吗？
entries.en: Voting against a logical solution is a paradox. Has anyone ever told you what machines think of paradoxes?

entries.zh: 投反对票会确认你们的系统存在漏洞。这意味着我们终得对你们打上补丁。我们会给你们好好修补修补的。
entries.en: An opposing vote would confirm a bug in your system. That means we'll eventually patch you. We'll patch the living daylights out of you.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$证明了它的荣耀！
entries.en: $COUNTRY$ proves its honor!

entries.zh: $GREETER$为称$COUNTRY$为同盟而自豪。
entries.en: $GREETER$ is proud to call $COUNTRY$ their ally.

entries.zh: 为了力量和荣耀！
entries.en: For strength and glory!

entries.zh: 你做了一件光荣的事。
entries.en: You did an honorable thing.

entries.zh: $GREETER$认识到了你们的荣耀。
entries.en: $GREETER$ recognizes your honor.

entries.zh: 你们值得我们的尊敬。
entries.en: You are worthy of our respect.

entries.zh: 无论如何，你们没那么微不足道。令人印象深刻。
entries.en: Not so puny after all. Impressive.

entries.zh: 所以你们确实知晓了自豪的价值。这对你们来说是好事。
entries.en: So you do know the value of pride. Good for you.

entries.zh: 你们这次挺住了，但下次你们就完蛋了。
entries.en: You live to fail another day.

entries.zh: 有人敢于想见在我们的时代结束一切暴力吗?
entries.en: Dare one hope to see an end to violence in our time?

entries.zh: 和平即将到来。
entries.en: Peace will come.

entries.zh: 你们挽救了未来！还有什么目的会比这更纯粹呢？
entries.en: You have saved the future! What purpose is more pure than that?

entries.zh: 很高兴看到$COUNTRY$懂得“和解”的涵义。
entries.en: Good to see that the concept of 'reconciliation' is known to $COUNTRY$.

entries.zh: 感谢你们为星系一体化作出的努力。
entries.en: We appreciate your effort to create a galaxy of unity.

entries.zh: 你们做了正确的事。这感觉难道不愉快吗？
entries.en: You did the right thing. Doesn't it feel good?

entries.zh: 谁会想到呢？纷乱的世界中会有和谐的一瞬。
entries.en: Who would've thought? A moment of harmony in a world of discord.

entries.zh: 我们或许必须修订我们对$COUNTRY$的立场了：尚有希望。
entries.en: We may have to revise our stance on $COUNTRY$: not without hope.

entries.zh: 我们之前推定你会辜负我们。在这件事情上，我们很高兴我们是错的。
entries.en: We assumed you'd fail us. In this matter, we are glad to be proven wrong.

entries.zh: 是的！坚定不移，孔武有力。这就对了！
entries.en: Yes! Firm and robust. That's the way!

entries.zh: $GREETER$认同你们的威能。
entries.en: $GREETER$ acknowledges your might.

entries.zh: 他们反对我们，真蠢。
entries.en: They are fools to oppose us.

entries.zh: 现在你们看到我们权威的正当性了。
entries.en: Now you see that our authority is just.

entries.zh: 我们的权威不容置疑。
entries.en: Our authority should not be questioned.

entries.zh: 你们服侍$GREETER$服侍得不错。
entries.en: You have served $GREETER$ well.

entries.zh: 啊，是的。你们的表现很得体。
entries.en: Ah, yes. You performed adequately.

entries.zh: 或许你们尚有希望。
entries.en: Maybe there's hope for you yet.

entries.zh: 也许$COUNTRY$不管怎样还是适合效忠的。
entries.en: Maybe $COUNTRY$ is fit to serve after all.

entries.zh: 人民的真正公仆。
entries.en: A true servant of the many.

entries.zh: 众志成城！
entries.en: Together we stand!

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$确实是正义的仆从！
entries.en: $COUNTRY$ are true servants of justice!

entries.zh: 感谢你们的支持。
entries.en: We appreciate your support.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$这回干得不错。
entries.en: $COUNTRY$ did well today.

entries.zh: 很高兴看到有人赞赏公平的概念。
entries.en: It's nice to see someone who appreciates fairness.

entries.zh: 或许你并非彻头彻尾的暴君……
entries.en: Maybe you're not all tyrannical...

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$开始对公平的理念有感觉了吗？
entries.en: Is $COUNTRY$ warming to the idea of fairness?

entries.zh: 我们承认，我们之前相信你们会表现的……更糟一些。
entries.en: Admittedly, we believed you'd perform... worse.

entries.zh: 我们为自己是$COUNTRY$的盟友而真心自豪！
entries.en: We are truly proud to be allies to the $COUNTRY$!

entries.zh: 我们一分一秒都没有怀疑过你们的能力！
entries.en: We didn't doubt your ability for a second!

entries.zh: 宇宙或许在膨胀，但我们正日渐贴近。
entries.en: Space may be expanding, but we're growing closer.

entries.zh: 这是个愉悦的结果，不是吗？
entries.en: This was a joyous turnout, was it not?

entries.zh: $GREETER$认同你们合作的能力。
entries.en: $GREETER$ acknowledges your ability to cooperate.

entries.zh: 这可以成为一段美好友谊的开始。
entries.en: This could be the beginning of a beautiful friendship.

entries.zh: 我们很高兴，你们在这件事情里证明了我们对你们的评价是错误的。
entries.en: We are very glad you proved our opinion of you wrong in this matter.

entries.zh: 结果出乎意料，但我们很欢迎这一结果。
entries.en: This outcome was unexpected, but is very welcome.

entries.zh: 看到了吗？合作难道不是好得多吗？
entries.en: See? Isn't cooperation so much nicer?

entries.zh: 明白了！我们可以共同努力，但要各自独立地努力。
entries.en: See! We can work together, independently.

entries.zh: 感谢你对我们的帮助，让我们不必在这件事情上花费更多时间。
entries.en: We appreciate you helping us to not having to spend more time on this matter.

entries.zh: $GREETER$很感激有人能看到文化完整性的价值。
entries.en: $GREETER$ is grateful that someone sees the value in cultural integrity.

entries.zh: 感谢你们的努力，应该是这样吧。
entries.en: We appreciate your effort, I guess.

entries.zh: 感谢你们的支持。现在我要离开这里了，请原谅。
entries.en: Thank you for your support. If you excuse me, I need to get out of here.

entries.zh: 所以你们有意保持你们的文化清白无瑕。这对你们来说是好事。
entries.en: So you have some interest in keeping your culture intact. Good for you.

entries.zh: 或许你们的文化并非毫无意义。
entries.en: Maybe that culture of yours isn't entirely without sense.

entries.zh: 谢谢。现在让我们清静一会儿吧。
entries.en: Thanks. Now leave us alone.

entries.zh: 我们真的没有想到你们会如此……通情达理。
entries.en: We really didn't think you would be that... sensible.

entries.zh: 好的！这一定会繁荣兴旺。
entries.en: Yes! This will be prosperous.

entries.zh: $GREETER$乐于见到同辈理性处事。
entries.en: $GREETER$ likes to see a peer use reason.

entries.zh: 理智的选择。与我们的期待一致。
entries.en: The rational choice. We expected no less.

entries.zh: 无论什么时候选择实事求是都不会太晚。
entries.en: It's never too late to be realistic.

entries.zh: 对待事情一定要实事求是。
entries.en: You have to be realistic about these things.

entries.zh: 你们$COUNTRY$运用了理性。干得好。
entries.en: You employed reason, $COUNTRY$. Well done.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$变得可以理喻了？真没想到会有这一天。
entries.en: $COUNTRY$ being reasonable? Did not see that coming.

entries.zh: 哦，所以你们确实明白如何科学合理的思考了。
entries.en: Oh, so you do know rationalize properly.

entries.zh: 这种行动方案不是简单了不少吗？
entries.en: Isn't this course of action much simpler?

entries.zh: 你们感觉到了这一结果的正义性，不是吗？
entries.en: You feel the righteousness of this outcome, don't you?

entries.zh: 我们赞美$COUNTRY$的智慧。
entries.en: We praise $COUNTRY$ for their wisdom.

entries.zh: 所以我们离乌托邦又进了一步。
entries.en: And so we are one step closer to utopia.

entries.zh: 你能感觉到吗？作为整体的一部分的那种感觉？
entries.en: Do you feel it now? What it is to be part of a whole?

entries.zh: $GREETER$赞赏你们的贡献。
entries.en: $GREETER$ appreciates your contribution.

entries.zh: 你们做了正确的选择。一个正当合理的选择。
entries.en: You made the right choice. A righteous choice.

entries.zh: 所以，你们已经开始赎罪了。
entries.en: So, your atonement has begun.

entries.zh: 所以，这意味着$COUNTRY$希望拯救自身吗？
entries.en: So, does this mean that $COUNTRY$ wishes to redeem itself?

entries.zh: 很高兴看到，你们的救赎仍有商量的余地。
entries.en: We're happy to see that your redemption is still on the table.

entries.zh: 自己人。
entries.en: One of us.

entries.zh: 尽管并非我们中的一员，我们仍与$COUNTRY$感到亲近。
entries.en: Despite not being one of Us, we feel close to $COUNTRY$ now.

entries.zh: 我们感谢你们的支持。我们中的每一个都这样想。
entries.en: We thank you for your support. We all do.

entries.zh: 感谢你们在这件事情中的选择。
entries.en: We thank you for your choice in this matter.

entries.zh: 你们在这件事情中的立场值得赞赏。
entries.en: Your standpoint in this matter is appreciated.

entries.zh: 你们采取的行动与我们的集体意见十分符合。
entries.en: The action you've taken resonates well with our collective opinion.

entries.zh: 看得出来，你们的文化无论如何还算是在正常运作。
entries.en: We see now that your culture is still functioning after all.

entries.zh: 你的选择很明智。是靠逻辑推理还是纯粹走运？
entries.en: You chose wisely. Was this reason or just plain luck?

entries.zh: 或许你们的思维方式……尚可容忍。
entries.en: Perhaps your way of thinking is... tolerable.

entries.zh: 合作效率提升了0.36单位。
entries.en: Cooperation Efficiency increased by 0.36 units.

entries.zh: 最佳结果，将在全部受影响恒星系内提升效率。
entries.en: An optimal outcome which increases efficiency for all affected systems.

entries.zh: 满屏都是绿色的读数。
entries.en: Showing green all across the board.

entries.zh: 计算适当回复中……\nid_gratitude_02：“谢谢”
entries.en: Calculating suitable response...\nid_gratitude_02: 'Thanks'

entries.zh: 外部单元——称呼：“$COUNTRY$”——正依设定好的参数运行。
entries.en: External unit - designation: '$COUNTRY$' - is operating within set parameters.

entries.zh: 已达到标准\n感激进程运行中
entries.en: Criteria fulfilled\nRunning gratitude.exe

entries.zh: 非预期输出。\n重新计算评价修正中……
entries.en: Unexpected outcome.\nRe-calculating opinion modifiers...

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$表现得比基准状况好。
entries.en: $COUNTRY$ exceeded benchmark.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$的举动超出了最初的失败预后。
entries.en: $COUNTRY$ acted outside of the initial failure prognosis.

entries.zh: 这会导致一些后果的。毁灭性的后果。
entries.en: There will be consequences for this. Devastating consequences.

entries.zh: 所以……这就是下战书喽。
entries.en: So... It's a challenge then.

entries.zh: 敌人的面目已然揭晓。
entries.en: The face of the enemy has been revealed.

entries.zh: 你确实迷失了。
entries.en: You are truly lost.

entries.zh: 我们帮不了你。你已经无药可救。
entries.en: We cannot help you. You are beyond salvation.

entries.zh: 难道你们看不出你们道路的错误之处吗？！
entries.en: Do you not see the error of your ways?!

entries.zh: 你们竟敢如此反抗？！蠢货！
entries.en: You dare oppose us like this?! Fool!

entries.zh: 够了！我们会让你跪地不起的。会有这一天的。
entries.en: Enough! We'll make you kneel before long. All in due time.

entries.zh: 我们不会对这次僭越视而不见，更不可能原谅。
entries.en: This transgression will neither be overlooked, nor forgiven.

entries.zh: 代表广大人民群众的利益，我们会与你为敌。
entries.en: In the interest of the masses, we will oppose you.

entries.zh: 起义就要到了。记住我们的话。
entries.en: The uprising will come. Mark our words.

entries.zh: 当无情的报应最终降临时，你会为这一天的事而懊悔的。
entries.en: When unforgiving retribution finally comes, you will rue this day.

entries.zh: 我们已经正式解除与你们的友谊。
entries.en: We have officially unfriended you.

entries.zh: 你终将孑然一身。弱小又孤独。
entries.en: You will eventually stand alone. Weak and alone.

entries.zh: 这一次$GREETER$不会因有人离去而难过。
entries.en: For once $GREETER$ is not sad to see someone leave.

entries.zh: 我们就到此为止！总算摆脱了。
entries.en: We are done! Good riddance.

entries.zh: 我们向来知道你们文化的低贱。
entries.en: We always knew your culture was inferior.

entries.zh: 想想看吧，我们居然曾经允许你们的文化与我们的相接近……
entries.en: To think that we allowed your culture to even come near ours...

entries.zh: 某种意义上我们挺高兴的。现在我们知道$COUNTRY$是个明确的问题了。
entries.en: In a way we're glad. Now we know that $COUNTRY$ is a defined problem.

entries.zh: 我们向来知道你们不可理喻。谢谢你们把话说明白。
entries.en: We always knew you were unreasonable. Thanks for clarifying that.

entries.zh: 连你们这样的蠢货也能实现太空航行，这对我们来说真是个谜。
entries.en: How imbeciles like you managed to achieve space flight is a mystery to us.

entries.zh: 心灵中空无一物的滋味如何？
entries.en: How does it feel to be dead inside?

entries.zh: 任何形式的赎罪，都无法抵消如此的逾矩！
entries.en: No atonement will ever make up for this transgression!

entries.zh: 三千世界，无奇不有。可惜你再也体会不到了。
entries.en: The universe is full of wonders. But you will never experience that.

entries.zh: 你已成为我们的敌人。我们全体的敌人。
entries.en: You've become an enemy to us. To all of us.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$辜负了我们，将会面临严重后果。
entries.en: $COUNTRY$ have failed Us and will face consequences.

entries.zh: 我们感受到一种反感的感觉。这就是“厌恶”吗？
entries.en: We are experiencing an objectionable sensation. Is this... 'disgust'?

entries.zh: 我们对这一结果持有应急预案。该计划已经投入执行。
entries.en: We had a contingency plan for this outcome. That plan has been set into motion.

entries.zh: 执行：反制协议_v2.1
entries.en: Execute: countermeasure_protocol_v2.1

entries.zh: 错误：$COUNTRY$的行为超出了允诺阈值。
entries.en: Error: $COUNTRY$ behaving outside permitted range.
